test-metadata.description: Custom attribute names may contain hyphens after the `x-` prefix, as in `x-source-lang`. The ATTRIBNAME terminal in usx.rnc is `/[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]*?/`, which permits hyphens in the trailing character class. Previously only a single hyphen (the one in the `x-` prefix) parsed.
